text: Which genes with enhanced heart muscle expression show no antibody staining in cardiomyocytes?
plan: Tissue category (RNA): Heart muscle / Tissue enhanced AND Tissue expression (IHC): Heart muscle / cardiomyocytes / Not detected
understanding: The question asks for genes that have enhanced RNA expression in heart muscle tissue and have no detected immunohistochemical antibody staining in cardiomyocytes.
